unlock.title: Unlock
unlock.label_hint: Distinguishes multiple passwords, e.g. Work, Personal
unlock.pick_folder_hint: Unlock parameters live in the files, so pick a folder before typing a password
unlock.quick_hint: Enter a password to unlock encrypted files in this folder
unlock.add_more_hint_one: 1 password loaded. Enter another to see more files; the current one stays.
unlock.add_more_hint_other: {{count}} passwords loaded. Enter another to see more files; the current ones stay.
unlock.already_loaded: That password is already in use; nothing was added

busy.pinning: Downloading the whole file so it can be kept permanently…

encrypt.filename_keep_ext_desc: Easier to identify, but reveals the file format
encrypt.compress_desc: Helps text and documents a lot, barely affects already-compressed media
encrypt.thumbnail_desc: Images and videos get a small preview stored alongside. It is encrypted too — only visible with the password.
encrypt.thumbnail_frame_hint: Leave empty to pick 10% in, skipping black intro frames. Accepts 83, 1:23 or 00:01:23.
encrypt.thumbnail_frame_bad: Can't read that timestamp. Use 83, 1:23 or 00:01:23.
encrypt.strength_sensitive_desc: 1 GiB · about 2 s, heavy on mobile
encrypt.original_trash_desc: Can still be restored from the system Recycle Bin
encrypt.original_delete_desc: Cannot be undone, and complete erasure is not guaranteed
encrypt.no_erase_note: Secure erase is not offered: SSD wear leveling means overwriting cannot guarantee removal.
encrypt.folder_note: Folder encryption is not implemented yet; selected folders will be skipped.
encrypt.folder_mode_container: Pack into a single encrypted file
encrypt.folder_mode_container_desc: Fully hides the directory structure; good for archiving and sharing. Changing any file rewrites the whole package.
encrypt.folder_mode_tree_desc: Supports incremental edits and cloud sync; individual files can be shared, and damage affects only one file.
encrypt.folder_mode_tree_leak: ⚠️ In per-file mode, others can see how many files you have, how large each one is, and how deep the directories go — but not the file names or contents.
encrypt.video_process_desc: Pick the cover frame while watching, and optionally convert before encrypting
encrypt.slot_mode_deniable_desc: Nobody can tell how many passwords this file has — not even you. Trade-off: removing a password later can only "keep the current one and clear the rest", which also wipes the recovery code
encrypt.slot_mode_managed_desc: Shows what each slot is (password / recovery code / device) and lets you remove one precisely while keeping the others. Trade-off: anyone who can open the file can also see this list
encrypt.slot_mode_permanent: This choice cannot be changed after encryption — the mode lives in the file header, so switching means re-encrypting.

video.title: Video processing
video.frame_hint: The scrubber, the timecode and the picture are three views of one value — change any of them and the others follow. Leave it empty to take the frame at one tenth of the duration, past the opening black frames.
video.none_desc: Encrypt as is; quality and size are untouched. Fastest and safest — nothing is re-encoded.
video.remux_desc: Changes only the container, never the video stream. As MP4 most files play directly, saving the on-the-fly remux at every playback.
video.compress_desc: Reduce resolution or bitrate to save space. Re-encodes, so it takes a while and costs some quality.
video.compress_blocked: Reduce resolution or bitrate to save space. Needs a video encoder, and this FFmpeg build has none.
video.compress_slow: Re-encoding is slow — a feature-length film can take tens of minutes. Please keep this window open.
video.faststart: faststart (move the index to the front)
video.faststart_desc: Without it, progressive playback must read to the end of the file before it can start
video.audio_drop_warn: ⚠️ This file's audio track is {{codec}}, which the target container cannot hold, and this FFmpeg has no AAC encoder — the result will have no sound. Switch to a full FFmpeg build, or choose MKV, to keep the audio.
video.sub_bitmap_warn: ⚠️ These are graphical subtitles (the Blu-ray / DVD kind — actually images). MP4 can neither hold them nor turn them into text, so they will disappear. Choosing MKV keeps them untouched.
video.sub_to_text_desc: Text is kept, but fonts, colours, positioning and effects are lost.
video.sub_keep_style_desc: Requires the MKV container; slightly less compatible, but subtitles are untouched
video.sub_outcome_none: This file has no subtitle track.
video.sub_outcome_copy: Subtitles are kept as they are, styling included.
video.sub_outcome_to_mov_text: Subtitles become mov_text, MP4's standard text format; the content is unchanged.
video.sub_outcome_to_mov_text_lossy: Subtitles become mov_text — the words survive, the styling does not.
video.sub_outcome_drop: The result will carry no subtitles.
video.sub_outcome_bitmap_drop: Graphical subtitles cannot enter this container and will disappear.
video.sub_outcome_style_drop: With the current settings the subtitles will be dropped.
video.sub_style_needs_mkv: ⚠️ "Keep full styling" is selected but the target is still MP4, which cannot carry styled subtitles — they would be dropped.
video.caps_note: This FFmpeg build cannot compress video. The bundled one is trimmed to probing, frame extraction and remuxing, and carries no video encoder at all. Compression becomes available automatically with a full FFmpeg build — omy prefers the program named by OMY_FFMPEG, and you can also overwrite the files in the ffmpeg folder next to the application.
video.converted_no_audio: Note: the result has no audio track.
video.converted_no_subs: Note: the result has no subtitle track.
video.foot_frame_auto: Cover frame chosen automatically (one tenth in)

playback.cannot_preview: This format cannot be previewed in the app

view.empty_hint: Pick a place on the left to start browsing
view.start_hint: Browse files freely and encrypt what you select; double-click an encrypted file and enter its password to view it
view.name: Name

kind.encrypted: Encrypted with your current omy password. On the next cold start you'll need to unlock that omy password before entering this location.

device.title: Devices & sharing
device.store_explain: The device store password protects this device's identity and its paired-device list. It is not the password for your encrypted files. Set one on first use.
device.fingerprint_hint: When pairing, check that both devices show the same fingerprints. A mismatch means someone is in the middle.
device.none_found: No devices found. Check that the other device is sharing and on the same network.
device.name_untrusted: Device names come from the other device's broadcast and cannot be trusted. Go by the fingerprint.
device.enter_pin: Pairing code shown on the other device
device.pin_hint: On the other device choose "Pair a device", enter this machine's address and port {{port}}, then type the code above. The code is valid for 2 minutes.
device.verify_hint: Confirm the other device shows these same two fingerprints.
device.share_no_password: Sharing does not need your file password: this device only sends ciphertext, and decryption happens on the other device. They still need the password to see anything.
device.share_no_peer: No devices paired yet, so nobody can connect.

remote.empty: This device is not sharing any files
remote.empty_hint: Ask them to pick a folder to share on their device.

errors.load_failed: Can't open this location. It may not exist or be readable.
errors.already_exists: A file or folder with that name already exists
errors.encrypted_dir_rename: Encrypted directories cannot be renamed; the name would become unrecoverable

recovery.restore_title: Reset password with a recovery code
recovery.generate_hint: A recovery code is 26 words. If you forget the password, it opens this file and lets you set a new one.
recovery.generate_why_password: You have to prove you can open this file today before adding another way in.
recovery.write_it_down: Write it on paper and keep it where you keep important documents. Do not photograph it, and do not put it in a notes app or a cloud-synced password manager entry.
recovery.warn_once: These words are shown only once. After you close this window they cannot be shown again — you would have to generate a new set, invalidating this one.
recovery.warn_weakest: It opens the file just like a password does. Whoever holds that paper can open it, which makes it the floor on this file's security.
recovery.warn_no_scan: A file opened with a recovery code does not join directory scanning, so filenames in the list stay hidden. That is deliberate: a recovery code is an emergency way in, not a second everyday password.
recovery.warn_evicted: This used a new slot and may have overwritten another password that was there. Empty slots cannot be detected, so we can only tell you this is possible.
recovery.acknowledge: I have written it down and understand it will not be shown again
recovery.restore_hint: Enter the 26 words you wrote down, then choose a new password.
recovery.code_hint: 26 words separated by spaces or newlines. Case and extra whitespace are ignored.
recovery.restore_note: The recovery code stays valid. You have already forgotten the password once, so removing your only fallback now is not advisable.
recovery.generated_toast: Recovery code generated — write it down now
recovery.restored_toast: Password reset; the recovery code still works

keymgmt.title: Manage passwords
keymgmt.slots_hidden: How many passwords this file has cannot be determined: unused slots are filled with random data, indistinguishable from real ones. This is part of the deniability design.
keymgmt.add_desc: Both the current and the new password will open this file.
keymgmt.change_desc: The current password will no longer work afterwards.
keymgmt.remove_desc: Every other password on this file stops working (if there are any).
keymgmt.current_hint: Every operation above needs a password that can already open this file.
keymgmt.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match
keymgmt.same: The new password is the same as the current one
keymgmt.stale_copy_warning: Removing a password only affects this copy of the file. If it was copied, backed up or synced elsewhere, those copies can still be opened with the removed password. To make this file unrelated to the old password, choose "Re-encrypt" above.
keymgmt.payload_note: Only the header is rewritten; the content is not re-encrypted, so this is instant even for huge files.
keymgmt.done_add: Password added; both passwords now work
keymgmt.done_change: Password changed; the old one no longer works
keymgmt.done_remove: Only the current password is kept now
keymgmt.locked_hint: You need to be able to open this file before changing its passwords.
keymgmt.reencrypt_desc: Rewrites the whole file and replaces its file key. This file will no longer relate to the old password, but it takes time proportional to the file size.
keymgmt.reencrypt_warning: This file will be rewritten in full; large files may take a while, so please keep the app open. Afterwards the old password is useless for this file — but any copies made earlier are separate files and can still be opened with it.
keymgmt.next_optional_hint: Leave empty to keep the password and replace only the file key, so older copies stop opening with it.
keymgmt.rewrite_note: The contents are re-encrypted, so this takes as long as the file is big. The original is left untouched until the write succeeds.
keymgmt.done_reencrypt: Re-encrypted; the file key has been replaced
keymgmt.tree_single_password: This folder can carry several passwords, and each one opens the whole tree. As with a single file, how many it has cannot be probed.
keymgmt.tree_warning: The folder name is encrypted with its own directory key, independent of any password, so changing the password leaves the name alone and the list will not jump.
keymgmt.tree_sidecar_notice: Every encrypted folder contains a .omy-keys file — the key that unlocks the folder's name. Delete it and that name can never be recovered: the files inside are still there, but all you will see is a string of gibberish. Keep it with the folder when copying or moving.
keymgmt.tree_reencrypt_warning: Every file in this tree will be rewritten; this takes time proportional to the total data size. Afterwards the old file keys are useless — but copies that already left your machine are separate ciphertext and still open with the password they had.
keymgmt.slots_deniable: This file uses deniable mode, so the number of passwords is not visible. You can only keep the current password and clear the rest, not remove one specific password.
keymgmt.slot_remove_confirm: Remove slot {{index}} ({{kind}})? This cannot be undone.
keymgmt.slot_remove_last: This is the last key that can open the file — removing it locks you out for good.
keymgmt.slots_note_managed: This file uses manageable mode: enter the password to see what each slot holds, and remove one precisely while keeping the others.
keymgmt.ok_remove_slot: That password was removed; the others are unaffected

restore.target_pick_desc: Pick a location with the button below
restore.pick_title: Choose a folder to restore into
restore.pick_failed: Could not open the folder picker
restore.overwrite_desc: When off, existing files are skipped and reported
restore.container_note: A folder is restored as a directory of the same name, keeping its structure
restore.plaintext_note: Restored files are unencrypted — mind where you put them
restore.meta_not_recorded: modification time of single files (not saved at encryption)

ctx.single_only: Works on a single item only
ctx.key_needs_unlocked_file: Select a single unlocked encrypted file
ctx.recovery_needs_unlocked_file: Select a single unlocked encrypted file or folder
ctx.recovery_needs_file: Select a single encrypted file or folder
ctx.rename_encrypted_dir: This is an encrypted directory; its name is the ciphertext and renaming it would make the name unrecoverable
ctx.in_container_hint: Items inside a container have no file of their own on disk. Restore to disk first.
ctx.name_bad_trailing: Name cannot end with a dot or space

settings.title: Settings
settings.thumbnails_hint: Thumbnails are stored in the file header; showing them does not read the file body.
settings.scan_scope_desc: Each remote file costs one request. Scanning all files is noticeably slower.
settings.concurrency_desc: Not a performance knob but a rate-limit boundary — raising it invites throttling.
settings.cache_ciphertext_note: The cache stores ciphertext only, identical to what is on the server; decrypted content is never written to disk.
settings.auto_lock_desc: Locking clears session keys; you will need the password again. Playback does not count as idle.
settings.lock_on_background_desc: When on, locks the instant you background the app (even during playback) to prevent task-switcher snapshots; when off, backgrounding only counts as idle and playback is not locked.
settings.wipe_temp: Delete as soon as the external app closes
settings.recovery_hint: A forgotten password means permanent data loss; it cannot be recovered. Generate a recovery code from the right-click menu.
settings.encrypt_defaults_note: These are only the initial values of the encrypt dialog; already-encrypted files are unaffected.
settings.original_action_desc: Kept by default. Deleting originals is irreversible and should not be the default.
settings.manage_devices_desc: Pair, list and revoke trusted devices (requires unlocking the device store).
settings.portable_desc: In portable mode, copying that folder takes all settings and cache with it.
settings.about_license_value: Core libraries such as omy-core are MIT OR Apache-2.0; omy-media is LGPL-2.1; this app is GPL-3.0-or-later.
settings.cache_pinned_hint: This does not count towards the limit above and is never cleared automatically.
settings.pinned_empty: No files are kept permanently yet
settings.pinned_empty_hint: Right-click a remote file and choose "Keep permanently" to store it in full on this machine, outside the cache limit.
settings.pinned_unpin_failed: Could not stop keeping this file
settings.pinned_list_failed: Could not read the list of permanent files
settings.log_desc: Records actions and errors for troubleshooting; no passwords or codes. Oldest logs are dropped automatically when the size limit is reached.

rplace.title: Remote locations
rplace.name: Name
rplace.writable_desc: Leave unchecked to mount read-only, guarding against mistakes.
rplace.url_scheme: The URL must start with http:// or https://
rplace.empty_hint: Connect a WebDAV NAS or cloud drive to browse and play encrypted files in place.
rplace.err_not_encrypted: This is not an OMYFILE encrypted file and cannot be played online.
rplace.err_locked: This file's password is not in the current session. Unlock the matching vault locally first.
rplace.open_failed: Could not open the remote file
rplace.decrypt_pick_title: Choose a folder to save the decrypted file
rplace.upload_partial: Uploaded {{ok}}. These did not go through: {{names}}
rplace.pinned: Kept on this machine; it opens offline now
rplace.unpinned: No longer kept permanently; it counts towards the cache limit again
rplace.unpin_failed: Could not stop keeping it permanently.
rplace.detach_confirm: Remove "{{name}}" from the list? The sign-in stays on this machine, so you can add it back without scanning again. Files kept permanently also stay on disk — clear them from the permanent cache in Settings.
rplace.delete_account_confirm: Delete "{{name}}" and erase the sign-in saved on this machine? You will have to scan a QR code or import tdata again to use this account. This cannot be undone.
rplace.rename_prompt: Display name for "{{name}}" on this machine
rplace.detached: Removed from the list; the sign-in is kept
rplace.detach_note: The saved login stays on this machine; you can add it back without scanning again.
rplace.delete_account_note: Also deletes the saved login. You would have to scan or import again.
rplace.protected_note: This chat has Protected Content enabled. Opening and playing files here is unaffected; forwarding or saving in Telegram is not possible.
rplace.mark_cached: Cached; may be evicted when space runs low
rplace.mark_partial: Partially cached: {{n}}/{{total}} blocks local; may not open fully offline
rplace.encrypt_note: Protect its sign-in with a password; you can't enter it while locked.
rplace.encrypted: Encrypted: on the next cold start you'll need the password you set to enter
rplace.encrypt_offer: Set a password to encrypt this Telegram location? Once encrypted you can't enter it while locked; otherwise it keeps the default protection. You can change this anytime by right-clicking it in the sidebar.
rplace.encrypt_dialog_hint: Set a password to protect this location's sign-in. Once encrypted, the next cold start needs it to enter; a matching omy password you've already unlocked opens it too.

tg.qr_why: Scan with Telegram on your phone. No phone number or verification code needed.
tg.proxy_desc: Enter a socks5:// address. http:// is retried as SOCKS5 on the same port.
tg.no_persist: This machine has no usable system credential store, so the sign-in state cannot be saved safely. You can still sign in and use Telegram, but you will have to scan again every time omy starts. omy will not fall back to writing login credentials to disk in plaintext.
tg.qr_how: On your phone open Telegram → Settings → Devices → Scan QR code
tg.qr_is_credential: This QR code is itself a login credential — do not screenshot or share it.
tg.qr_refreshed: The QR code expired and was replaced (#{{n}}). Scan the new one.
tg.migrating_desc: This is a normal step of signing in, not a failure. Please keep waiting and do not close this.
tg.need_password: This account has two-step verification enabled
tg.need_password_desc: Enter your Telegram cloud password. It is not your phone's lock screen password, and not your omy password.
tg.session_saved: The sign-in state is stored on this machine, encrypted with the system credential store. You can terminate this session at any time under "Active sessions" in an official client.
tg.session_not_saved: This sign-in lasts only for the current run: this machine has no usable credential store, so nothing was saved and you will need to scan again next time.
tg.flood_wait: This is a rate limit imposed by Telegram's servers, not an omy error. Please wait {{secs}}s before trying again — retrying repeatedly only makes the wait longer.
tg.already_desc: A usable sign-in is stored on this machine, so there is no need to scan again. You can terminate this session at any time under "Active sessions" in an official client.
tg.tdata_desc: Read the tdata folder of Telegram Desktop on this machine and reuse the sign-in it already has, with no QR code.
tg.tdata_running: Telegram Desktop is running. Quit it first; closing the window is not enough, quit from the tray.
tg.tdata_path_hint: For the portable build, pick the tdata folder next to Telegram.exe. The installed build normally keeps it in %APPDATA%\Telegram Desktop\tdata.
tg.tdata_autofound: This location was found automatically. Use it as is, or change it.
tg.tdata_not_found: No tdata found automatically. Pick it manually — the portable build keeps tdata next to Telegram.exe.
tg.tdata_bad_dir: This folder holds no Telegram Desktop sign-in data. Check that you picked the tdata folder itself.
tg.tdata_passcode_hint: This is the local passcode you set for the Telegram Desktop app itself — the one it asks for on launch. It is not your two-step verification cloud password, and not an SMS code.
tg.tdata_shared: Importing shares one login session with the desktop app: signing out on either side ends both. That is also why there is no "sign out the desktop only" option.
tg.proxy_auto: Filled in from this machine’s proxy settings. Use as is, or change it.
tg.conn_bad_proxy: That proxy address is malformed. Fix it, then check.
tg.conn_no_route_direct: No direct route. Most networks need a socks5:// proxy here.
tg.conn_no_route_proxy: Cannot reach Telegram through this proxy. Check that it is running and the port is right.
tg.proxy_scheme_hint: Only socks5:// is supported. http:// is retried as SOCKS5 on the same port.
tg.req_running_bad: Telegram Desktop is running — quit it first
tg.req_path_bad: No valid tdata folder selected yet
tg.api_hint: Get one at my.telegram.org. Both fields are required.
tg.api_saved: Saved. Takes effect on the next connection.
tg.risk_title: Risks of signing in with a third-party client
tg.risk_1: Telegram may place the account under review, and in serious cases restrict or ban it.
tg.risk_2: omy appears as “omy” in your Logged-in Devices list, where you can terminate it at any time.
tg.risk_ack: I understand these risks and want to continue
tg.method_qr_desc: Scan with the Telegram app — the simplest way
tg.method_phone_desc: Sign in with a code sent to your phone
tg.method_tdata_desc: Use this machine's Telegram Desktop login
tg.phone_desc: Enter your number with country code, e.g. +14155550123

code.sentToApp: The code was sent to your other logged-in Telegram apps (not by SMS). Open Telegram on your phone or desktop to see it.
code.sentToSms: The code was sent by SMS.
code.sentToCall: The code will be read out in a phone call.
code.sentToFlashCall: You will get a flash call; the last digits of the number are the code.

tg.account_already_added: This account is already added; switched to it.

devicekey.enroll_hint: After this, opening this location only needs Windows Hello.
devicekey.enroll_done: Enabled. Next time, Windows Hello is enough.
devicekey.forget_done: Turned off. A password is needed from now on.
devicekey.not_available: This PC cannot use passwordless unlock
devicekey.not_available_hint: It needs TPM 2.0 and a configured Windows Hello; Windows only for now.
devicekey.not_enrolled_hint: This location has no passwordless unlock yet. Open it with a password first, then enable it in Settings.
devicekey.warn_not_safer: It saves typing, not risk. It protects a stolen disk or another computer, not malware running on this one.
devicekey.warn_can_be_lost: Replacing the PC, reinstalling the OS, clearing the TPM or resetting Windows Hello makes it permanently unrecoverable. Keep remembering your password; this is not a backup.

search.local_hint: Matches real file names among items already loaded on this machine. The search term never leaves your device
search.server_hint: Sends the search term to Telegram’s servers and searches the whole chat
search.local_banner: Matching real file names among items already loaded here. The term stays on this machine. Use "Search whole chat" to cover everything.
search.server_banner: The term "{{q}}" was sent to Telegram servers. They search message text only, not the real names of encrypted files.
search.locked_out_one: 1 encrypted file is locked and was not searched; it appears once unlocked
search.locked_out_other: {{count}} encrypted files are locked and were not searched; they appear once unlocked

msgs.stat: {{total}} messages on this screen — {{files}} with files, {{texts}} text-only
msgs.locate_not_found: Message not found — it may have been deleted

xfer.title: Transfers
xfer.empty_hint: Uploads and files you keep permanently show up here.
xfer.slow_note: Telegram rate-limits downloads for non-Premium accounts. This is not omy’s ceiling.
